intro: {{nameA}} is recorded in {{cityA}} and {{nameB}} is recorded in {{cityB}}, and both offer {{course}} programmes listed with CAT. This page compares the fees and placements we can use, Times ranks from our table, and official sites opened in {{year}}.
IMS Unison University vs Quantum University is a Uttarakhand MBA comparison. One side has no fee row here, and Quantum's only placement row is from 2018.

sections.heading: IMS Unison University vs Quantum University for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose IMS Unison University if you want a CAT-listed MBA in Dehradun, with a 2023 row of ₹3 lakh average and ₹7 lakh highest, and a Times 2024 rank of 18 on our records, after you confirm the official fee.
Choose Quantum University if you want recorded Total Fees of ₹1.40 lakh a year on several MBA specialisations in Roorkee, and a Times 2024 rank of 57, after official confirmation.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For IMS Unison University we hold no fee row on this page for MBA. Do not invent a programme total, and confirm the official notice on iuu.ac before you budget.
For Quantum University we hold ₹1.40 lakh as a Total Fees year figure for MBA International Business, Supply Chain & Operations, Finance, Marketing, Human Resource Management and Economics.
That Quantum figure is a year row, not a confirmed official two-year total, and we have not multiplied it.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: IMS Unison University has a 2023 MBA row of ₹3 lakh average and ₹7 lakh highest. Treat that as a historical record and ask for a later official report if you need one.
Quantum University has only a 2018 MBA International Business row, with a highest of ₹10 lakh and no usable average. That year is too old to treat as a current flagship figure.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: Both are listed with CAT. Confirm each university's current official admission note, because accepted tests can change by cycle.
On our records, IMS Unison University has a Times 2024 MBA / PGDM rank of 18. Quantum University has a Times 2024 rank of 57. These are not NIRF ranks.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: IMS Unison University is recorded in Dehradun. Quantum University is recorded in Roorkee, even though its profile slug mentions Dehradun. They are not the same city.
Both are private universities. Visit the campus you would actually join.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick IMS Unison University if the Dehradun campus, the 2023 placement row and the Times 2024 rank of 18 matter more, after you have a written official fee.
Pick Quantum University if the Roorkee campus and the recorded ₹1.40 lakh year fee fit you, after official confirmation, without using the 2018 placement row as a current figure.
Do not multiply the Quantum year fee, and do not invent an IMS Unison fee.
